entities.name: Merret
entities.description: A low-skilled covert agent of House Dimir working the Ravnican docks, husband of Tashi and father of Soche and a baby, who drinks stolen Elixir of Focus and is drawn into Lazav's plans for his son.

entities.name: Grimbly Wothis
entities.description: A minotaur dock boss, half-man and half-bull, who employs Merret, bullies him and tries to seize his baby son.

entities.name: Tashi
entities.description: Merret's wife, who brews healing salves to sell at market and is injured protecting her baby.

entities.name: Soche
entities.description: Merret and Tashi's oldest child, a brave girl who throws wooden blocks at Wothis.

entities.name: Merret's Baby
entities.description: Merret's nearly one-year-old son who, after tasting the elixir stain, lights candles with a sneeze, vanishes and reappears, and walks for the first time into Lazav's arms.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Guildmaster of House Dimir, who appears in Merret's armchair, forces Wothis to back off and offers to fund and tutor Merret's gifted son.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive Ravnican guild of spies and mind mages that employs Merret as a covert agent.

entities.name: Great Aunt Bea
entities.description: Tashi's aunt who suddenly appears in the armchair after Lazav alters the family's memories.

entities.name: Yantis
entities.description: A Viashino dockworker who operates the crane and is subjected to Merret's nightmare spell.

entities.name: Warwick
entities.description: A dock coworker whom Merret suggests could clear the fog.

entities.name: Bender
entities.description: A dock coworker who is out the day Merret must clear the fog.

entities.name: Wothis's Wife
entities.description: Grimbly Wothis's minotaur wife who catches Merret in her kitchen and is made oblivious to him by his magic.

entities.name: Keyhole Village
entities.description: The gloomy Ravnican neighborhood with tenements where Merret's family lives.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Elixir of Focus
entities.description: A blue enchanted elixir that sharpens magic; Merret steals and spills it, and traces of it empower his baby.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Selesnya guild whose forests are poached for whiskey casks.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Simic guild, whose schooner and merfolk escorts disguise the ship in the river.

events.summary: Merret, working the docks as a Dimir agent, nearly pockets a bottle of expensive whiskey from a crate before his boss approaches and he hides it.
Grimbly Wothis orders Merret to clear the fog from the harbor for an investor, threatening to dock his pay.
events.quote: How's this for confidence . . . you don't clear it and you don't get your pay for today?

events.summary: Merret barely thins the fog and reveals a Simic schooner cloaking itself, which Wothis uses as a selling point to the investor.
events.quote: Fog swirls, barely, clearing about halfway to the other side of the river

events.summary: Merret returns to his cramped home in Keyhole Village, where Tashi demands he find real food for the hungry baby.
events.quote: Get the food, Merret. I don't care how.

events.summary: Failing to steal from a posh grocer, Merret breaks into Grimbly Wothis's apartment through an unlocked window.
events.quote: I round the building, make a quick hop to the balcony, and sure enough, find an unlocked window.

events.summary: Merret takes a loaf of bread and drinks drops of an Elixir of Focus from Wothis's kitchen.
events.quote: Just one more, for good measure.

events.summary: Wothis's wife enters the kitchen, and the elixir sharpens Merret's magic enough to make himself invisible to her.
events.quote: I draw on magic, and her mind opens up to me like a map.

events.summary: Empowered, Merret clears the whole harbor, then in a show-off moment casts a nightmare on the crane operator Yantis, dropping a crate of whiskey toward Wothis and the investor.
events.quote: Yantis screams, fighting all the terrifying nothings in front of him.

events.summary: Wothis shoves the investor into the river and jumps in as the crate smashes; Merret fears House Dimir will erase him.
events.quote: Nope, there's nothing covert about ruining a thousand zinos worth of cargo.

events.summary: Merret's baby, healthy after gnawing elixir-stained bread, sneezes and every candle in the apartment ignites.
events.quote: Then baby sneezes, and every single candle in our apartment bursts into flame.

events.summary: Wothis breaks into the apartment, beats Merret and demands the child, saying he saw the candle trick through the window.
events.quote: I saw what that child did through the window, the trick with the candles.

events.summary: Merret weaves a nightmare in Wothis's mind but loses focus when Wothis nears Soche, and Wothis seizes the baby.
events.quote: And like that, my baby is in Grimbly Wothis's arms

events.summary: Wothis kicks Merret in the mouth and throws Tashi into a cabinet, breaking her ribs.
events.quote: With a hard shake, he flings her off.

events.summary: The baby gets magically gripped, vanishes from Wothis's arms and reappears on the floor holding a strange purple star-shaped fruit.
events.quote: My son arches his back again, throws his arms up, and suddenly, he's gone.

events.summary: Merret notices Lazav sitting in the armchair, and the baby takes his first steps into Lazav's arms.
events.quote: Could this be Lazav? Lazav the Mastermind, Guildmaster of House Dimir?

events.summary: Lazav orders Wothis to stay away from the family, and magically bends his will.
events.quote: Any outstanding debts Merret owes you will be paid in full by the close of business tomorrow

events.summary: Lazav offers to pay Merret's debts, give a stipend, and send a tutor to teach the gifted baby, who stays with the family.
events.quote: we would like to ask that we send a tutor to your home to oversee his learning

events.summary: Lazav's laugh scrambles the family's memories so that Great Aunt Bea seems to be staying with them.
events.quote: Lazav laughs a raspy laugh, like stones scratching against rib bone.

relations.quote: As a covert agent of House Dimir, I don't have much to offer except the ability to work a crowbar of malintent.

relations.note: Wothis is Merret's boss at the docks.
relations.quote: Merret!" says Grimbly Wothis, my boss
Lazav the Mastermind, Guildmaster of House Dimir?
get ready to break the news to my wife.
Soche, my oldest, comes barreling up to me
especially with what her husband pays me

relations.note: Wothis beats Merret and tries to take his son.
relations.quote: A child like this is worth something
